description: This file defines a set of custom exception classes used in the checkout service of an e-commerce application. It centralizes various domain-specific exceptions related to validation, orchestration, inventory reservation, and shipping quotes.

classes.name: CheckoutExceptions
classes.description: A final class containing static nested classes representing different checkout-related exceptions used to handle specific error scenarios in the checkout process.

methods.name: CheckoutValidationException
methods.description: Constructor creating a new RuntimeException for validation errors with a custom message.

methods.name: CheckoutOrchestrationException
methods.description: Constructor creating a new RuntimeException for orchestration errors with a message and underlying cause.

methods.name: CheckoutInventoryReservationException
methods.description: Constructor creating a new RuntimeException for inventory reservation errors with a message and cause.

methods.name: CheckoutShippingQuoteException
methods.description: Constructor creating a new RuntimeException for shipping quote failures with a message and cause.

methods.name: CheckoutShippingSelectionException
methods.description: Constructor creating a new RuntimeException for invalid shipping selections with a message.
